links.outcome: Effect of knowledge-graph and causal-graph grounding on LLM causal, evidence, unsupported-claim, and intervention accuracy metrics
links.effect: Integrated grounding (C4) had the best causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738) and unsupported claim rate (0.114); ungrounded C1 had the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948).
links.quote: The metric panel discriminates conditions along interpretable, non-redundant axes: C4 obtains the strongest causal edge F1 (0.838), adverse-effect F1 (0.833), evidence accuracy (0.738), and unsupported claim rate (0.114), while C1 obtains the highest raw intervention accuracy (0.948) with no measurable causal or evidential grounding.
